eligibility_evidence: The Senior Azure Engineer will take technical ownership of our Microsoft Azure platform, hybrid infrastructure, and Azure Virtual Desktop environment.
What You’ll Own Design, implement, and evolve Microsoft Azure and hybrid infrastructure across compute, storage, networking, identity, governance, security, monitoring, and cost management.

Engineer secure hybrid connectivity and name resolution using virtual networks, routing, network security groups, firewalls, private endpoints, Private DNS, VPN or ExpressRoute, and load-balancing services.
Lead complex cloud and hybrid incident resolution, perform root-cause analysis, drive vulnerability remediation, and eliminate recurring problems.

Ability to operate independently as a senior individual contributor, translate business requirements into supportable designs, and clearly communicate technical decisions, risks, and recommendations. Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), or equivalent demonstrated engineering expertise.
